events.name: Out of the Sky-Hole (arrival, once)
events.note: Autorun on arriving with Lasa (Story >= 30): words sky and sun, then Burning Touch. Self Switch A = done.

parameters: Scenes: "The Gully Walk", 1. Out of the sky-hole. Plays once, on arriving in Act 1.
Sky! That's the biggest thing there is.
...The sky heard you. It's not coming down.
And that's the sun. Don't look at it.
It's not scared of you. It's the sun.
It's hot, the sun. You could be hot too, you know.

events.name: The Kipuka Grass (lesson)

parameters: Gully lesson: 'grass' (Lasa in the party, Act 1). Self Switch B = done.
Grass. It grows where the fire didn't.
The grass doesn't mind. Grass never minds.
Grass comes back after the fire. You can wipe things clean too.
